A great quick weeknight dinner is **One-Pan Lemon Garlic Chicken with Veggies**:

**Ingredients:** 2 chicken breasts, 1 lb baby potatoes (halved), 1 broccoli crown (florets), 3 tbsp olive oil, 4 garlic cloves (minced), juice/zest of 1 lemon, 1 tsp oregano, salt/pepper.

**Method:** Preheat oven to 425°F. Toss potatoes with 1 tbsp oil, salt, pepper; roast 15 min. Push to sides, add chicken (rubbed with 1 tbsp oil, garlic, oregano, lemon zest, salt/pepper) and broccoli (tossed with 1 tbsp oil). Roast 18–20 min until chicken hits 165°F. Squeeze lemon over everything.

**Time:** ~35 min total, 5 min active. One pan, minimal cleanup.
